name: Extra Block Types (EBT): Carousel
description: Adds a Carousel block type whose slides (media image + caption + optional wrapping link) are rendered with the Tiny Slider vanilla-JS library; per-block slider and design options come from the shared EBT settings field.
project_description: Extra Block Types: Carousel adds a reusable "EBT Carousel" custom block type. Each block holds a repeatable "EBT Carousel item" paragraph (a media-library image, an optional long-text caption, and an optional link that wraps the whole slide), and renders the collection as a Tiny Slider carousel. Tiny Slider is a small vanilla-JavaScript slider (no jQuery for the slider itself), shipped locally via the levmyshkin/tiny-slider Composer package (loaded from /libraries with the module's own tiny-slider.js as fallback init wrapper). The block exposes an extensive per-block settings form (from ebt_core's EBT Settings field, extended by this module) covering slider mode (carousel vs gallery/fade), axis, slides-to-show/scroll, gutter/edge padding, auto/fixed width, speed, loop, auto height, responsive breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop), controls (prev/next text and position), navigation dots, autoplay (timeout, direction, hover-pause), and animation classes, plus the shared EBT design options (margin/border/padding box, border colour/style/radius, background colour, background media image/video with parallax/cover/overlay, edge-to-edge, container max width). Part of the Extra Block Types suite built on ebt_core; EBT blocks are intended to be placed in regions or dropped into Layout Builder sections in a few clicks. The paragraph slide image respects an optional image style chosen in the block settings.
